mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases (20-day horizon) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions characterized by low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%), labor market tightness accelerates corporate wage pressures and inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% (during late-cycle expansion as defined by other indicators).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines (12-month rolling basis).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1600 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when HOUST < 1600.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPI (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate an active monetary tightening cycle to combat inflation, which compresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases (20-day horizon) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansions marked by accelerating GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized), consumer and business confidence rises, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% (during early-cycle expansion as defined by other indicators).
